pages.title: Tools
pages.text: Hexalia introduces specialized tools used for rituals, gathering, and utility. Each serves a distinct purpose, often interacting directly with the natural and magical systems of the world.

pages.title: Hex Focus
pages.text: The Hex Focus is the primary magical tool used to activate rituals and interactions. It is used in $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/celestial_infusion)Celestial Infusion$(/l), $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual)Nature's Ritual$(/l), and to trigger certain enchanted plants. It can also transform Deepslate into a Ritual Table.

pages.title: Athame
pages.text: A precision tool used in both gathering and crafting. It extracts Tree Resin from specific logs, harvests Lotus Blossoms, and can shape planks into a Ritual Brazier when used while crouching.

pages.title: Briar Sickle
pages.text: A harvesting tool designed for clearing vegetation. It cuts through plants in a wide area and can be used with care to gather resources directly from blocks.

pages.title: Rootshaper
pages.text: A shifting tool that adapts to the material being mined. It functions as both a pickaxe and shovel, and can expand its reach to affect a wider area when used with intent.

pages.title: Spiritroot Tether
pages.text: A tool for capturing and relocating creatures. It stores a creature's essence and allows it to be released elsewhere, preserving its state. When bound to a Spirit Bloom, it can return creatures to that location.

pages.title: Ladle
pages.text: A simple but essential tool used in $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/brewing)Brewing$(/l). It is required to stir mixtures within the Small Cauldron and begin the cooking process.

pages.title: Sage Pendant
pages.text: A magical artifact that enhances experience gained when worn. Its power draws from the experience itself, gradually wearing down with use.

pages.title: On Craft
pages.text: Hexalia tools are closely tied to its systems. Mastery of them allows deeper interaction with rituals, resources, and the world itself.
